text: Clearbrief — client approvals, without the email chase clearbrief ↗ Pricing FAQ Fictional product for an Akapulu tutorial. No real subscriptions or customer accounts. For small creative teams Client approvals. Without the email chase. Clearbrief lets creative teams share work with clients, collect comments, and track approvals in one place. Find your answer Simple monthly pricing Solo $19 / month The Solo plan costs $19 per month and includes one team member and five active projects. Team $49 / month The Team plan costs $49 per month and includes five team members and twenty active projects. Both plans include unlimited client reviewers. Client reviewers can comment and approve work; they are not team members. Plans are billed monthly. Annual billing is not available. Frequently asked questions Can I try it first? Both plans offer a 14-day trial. A credit card is not required to start the trial. How do I get started? Create a workspace, add a project, and share a review link with your client. Client reviewers do not need an account. Will my clients count toward the team limit? Team members create and manage projects. Client reviewers only comment and approve work, and do not count toward the team-member limit. Can I cancel? You can cancel from workspace settings. Access continues until the end of the current paid billing period. What if I need more than five team members? For more than five team members, ask the Clearbrief team about your requirements. This website does not publish pricing for larger teams. Can I bring over my old projects? You can upload PDF and PNG files to a project. Automatic migration from another project-management service is not available. Avatar placement will be added after the knowledge-base and live-call rehearsal passes. This page currently has no live avatar. Clearbrief is a fictional demonstration. Pricing and policies above are sample data, not Akapulu Labs pricing or policies.
